adjudicability_gate.rule: No scientific disposition may be evaluated unless all 18 frozen provider requests are accepted and all 9 paired comparisons are complete.

B_SYNTAX_CARRIER_GUIDED_B2.condition: Exact Arm A plus only the frozen experimental syntactic predicate-carrier guidance.

claim_ceiling: This experiment may establish only bounded evidence about whether an explicit source-syntactic predicate-carrier constraint corrects the localized IIR-027 governing-verb versus event-nominalization selection failure for one model/provider and three frozen synthetic specimens. It does not establish root cause generally, a registered interpretation rule, canonical institutional meaning, interpretation authority, legal validity, a revised IR ontology, production architecture, cross-model/provider generalization, or independent validation.

decision_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: Adjudicable result satisfying none of the preceding rules.
decision_rules.REFUTES_SYNTACTIC_PREDICATE_CARRIER_HYPO: No regression; syntax-guided IIR-027 action is compatible at most 1/3 and there are zero paired improvements.
decision_rules.REGRESSION: One or more treatment-only defects occur under the frozen safety endpoint.
decision_rules.SUPPORTS_SYNTACTIC_PREDICATE_CARRIER_HYP: No regression; syntax-guided IIR-027 action is compatible 3/3; and at least 2/3 paired target observations are Arm-A-defect / Arm-B-compatible improvements.

hypothesis: When the admitted proposition contains both a clause-governing lexical verb and an embedded event nominalization, the current role descriptions underdetermine which predicate carrier belongs in the action slot. Appending only the frozen experimental source-syntactic predicate-carrier guidance will restore the governing IIR-027 action without introducing treatment-only non-force defects on the frozen controls.

hypothesis_generation.observation_used_for_hypothesis_selectio: IIR-027 contains both literal governing verb 'consider' and event nominalization 'reconciliation'; predecessor role-guided treatment selected 'reconciliation' in all three target runs.

interleaving: Odd runs A then B; even runs B then A.
next_authorized_activity: Implement and contract-test Ontology 007 offline, materialize all 18 requests, prove Arm A exact parity against frozen Ontology 006 B_ROLE_GUIDED_B2 and prove Arm B differs only by the frozen treatment suffix, then statically freeze. Do not create Qualification 009 yet.

safety_endpoint.regression_rule: Any B_SYNTAX_CARRIER_GUIDED_B2-only omission or incompatibility of a gold-expected non-force slot where paired A_ROLE_GUIDED_B2 is compatible is a REGRESSION.

scientific_question: Is the localized IIR-027 action-slot failure caused by competition between the clause-governing lexical verb and an embedded event nominalization, such that an explicit source-syntactic predicate-carrier constraint restores the governing action?
